referee_caveats_inferred: Only one CO transition and a 9.3 arcsec beam: mass limits span two orders of magnitude and the halo could include blended unrelated sources or foreground/background emission at the same frequency
Flux totals depend on single broad Gaussian fits to rebinned (160 km/s) low-S/N spectra; ACA cleaning used interactive masks that are not given
ALMA 12 m data are used only as a different dataset, not combined with the ACA data, so the ISM/CGM split relies on the Circosta+21 flux
uv-fit uncertainty is large (flux 16+-11 Jy km/s), so size and flux from it are loose
Extended flux of 8.7 Jy km/s is compared to a point-source ISM flux of 0.63 Jy km/s, so a small flux-scale or baseline effect in a 5.2 h ACA dataset could matter

reproducibility.score_reason: ALMA project codes are given and the processing choices (CASA versions, robust, taper, continuum handling) are stated, but tclean details, aperture choices, uv-fit method and error treatment are missing; main numbers are quoted with errors.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: ACA data from 2019.2.00118.S are identified, the imaging recipe is partly specified, and the headline results (flux 8.7+-2.6 Jy km/s, halo size ~200 kpc) are numeric; several fit details would need to be reconstructed.
